label: Roam
description: Automate Roam chat, users, groups and meetings

operations.name: get_token_info
operations.description: Inspect the connected principal, workspace and token grant; needs no scope.

operations.name: list_chats
operations.description: List one page of accessible chats. Requires chat:read.

operations.name: post_message
operations.description: Send a text message to one chat, group or set of DM recipients. Requires chat:send_message.

operations.name: update_message
operations.description: Replace a message's text. Requires chat:send_message and edit access.

operations.name: delete_message
operations.description: Delete a message the connected principal can delete. Requires chat:send_message.

operations.name: get_chat_history
operations.description: Read one page of messages in a chat. Requires chat:history.

operations.name: search_messages
operations.description: Search one page of accessible messages. Requires chat:history.

operations.name: add_reaction
operations.description: Add a message reaction. Requires chat:send_message and chat membership.

operations.name: remove_reaction
operations.description: Remove a message reaction. Requires chat:send_message.

operations.name: list_users
operations.description: List one page of workspace members. Requires user:read.

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Get a principal by ID. Requires user:read.

operations.name: list_groups
operations.description: List one page of visible groups. Requires group:read.

operations.name: get_group
operations.description: Read a visible group's details. Requires group:read.

operations.name: create_group
operations.description: Create a group with explicit initial members. Requires group:write.

operations.name: join_group
operations.description: Join a public group as the token owner. Requires group:write.

operations.name: search_meetings
operations.description: Search meeting transcripts and summaries using a personal token. Requires meetings:read.

operations.name: list_meetings
operations.description: List one page of meetings available to this token. Requires meetings:read.

operations.name: get_meeting
operations.description: Read a meeting, its summary and action items. Requires meetings:read.

operations.name: get_meeting_transcript
operations.description: Read the structured JSON transcript. Requires meetings:read.

operations.name: create_meeting_share_link
operations.description: Get or create a shareable meeting link. Requires meetings:read.shareLink.
